_status: Codes from the 2024-25 program diagram, plus six 4000-level courses supplied by the team and cross-checked against the advisor notes on a real audit. The catalog publishes no term grid for any course, so term availability comes from the program diagram and the schedule of classes; prerequisites, titles and credit hours come from the catalog. All 20 records verified.

_codes.format: two characters per term, in order Fa Sp Su
_codes.--: not offered at all that term

CPSC 3165._note: diagram header is Fa Sp May; May treated as summer

CPSC 4157._note: fall only; also online (team). Online ignored by default, so fall F2F.

CPSC 4000._note: Every term. The catalog requires it in "the last semester prior to graduation" (CPSC 4000, 0-0-0), and students graduate in fall, spring and summer, so it must be available in all three. Placement is driven by the final_term rule in prereqs.json, not by this row. Source: catalog.columbusstate.edu/course-descriptions/cpsc/
